query: Which uncertainty quantification approach (Monte Carlo propagation, Bayesian/variational UQ, ensemble methods, or bootstrap) best balances actionable uncertainty maps and computational cost for our benchmarks?

response.query: Which uncertainty quantification approach (Monte Carlo propagation, Bayesian/variational UQ, ensemble methods, or bootstrap) best balances actionable uncertainty maps and computational cost for our benchmarks?
response.answer: Bayesian/variational UQ balances actionable uncertainty maps and computational cost effectively. It provides precise uncertainty estimates while being more efficient than full Monte Carlo methods. Ensemble methods can also be effective but often require more computational resources.
